integrity: The proof reconstructs \(\operatorname{Aut}(B_n)\cong S_n\) from the singleton degree layer, characterizes pointwise stabilizers by coordinate-incidence signatures, obtains the information-theoretic lower bound, constructs sharp separating families, and counts all minimum families by injections into the binary cube modulo row order. The packaged checker exhaustively confirms the minimum-set counts through \(n=7\).
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers only \((\mathbb F_2)^n\) with \(n\ge2\).
The 2020 fixing-number paper on the same Boolean zero-divisor graph was accessible only through its abstract and publisher metadata; its full text could not be inspected.

The numerical determining number is not used as the sole originality contribution; the new content is the complete classification and exact count of minimum determining sets, plus the explicit obstruction to the later two-vertex Boolean construction.
title: Minimum determining sets of Boolean annihilating-ideal graphs
